terminal.emulator: direct PTY with redacted ANSI screen model

reference.capture: fresh direct PTY with synthetic-home empty-platform confirmation and repeated stable-surface readback

normalization: Reference checkout, synthetic HOME/HERMES_HOME paths, loopback URL, credentials, session identifiers, timestamps, raw config values, hashes, and animated redraw bytes are omitted or replaced by placeholders.

Only the displayed Full setup branch, synthetic loopback provider, palette-model default, and Keep current (local) backend are accepted; no platform is toggled, no credential or OAuth action is entered, and no external network is used.
Config evidence contains normalized key paths, scalar/container kinds, and byte counts only; artifact evidence is reduced to stable classes.
The empty-confirmation outcome is bounded by repeated identical rendered picker markers during a finite observation window and does not infer later setup behavior.

steps.precondition: Fresh Hermes process at 120x40 with an isolated synthetic home and configured synthetic loopback provider, navigated to the platform picker with every platform unselected.

input_sequence.meaning: clean exit from the unchanged platform picker

output.outcome: With no platform selected, Enter leaves Hermes on the same platform picker during the bounded observation window; no ready transition, error marker, config change, or new artifact class is observed.

unknowns: Whether Hermes treats an empty platform confirmation as a deliberate no-op indefinitely or eventually emits another status remains unobserved beyond the bounded observation window.
Platform cursor navigation, toggling, confirmation with one or more platforms, provider credentials, OAuth, endpoint editing, backend-specific setup, and later wizard continuation remain unobserved.
Config scalar values, YAML ordering/formatting, backup contents, and the identity of the normalized <other-file> artifact remain outside the claim.
The fresh-process readback proves only that the previously committed synthetic setup shape remains loadable after cleanup.
